title: India’s climate action plan fails to prioritise health, global scorecard finds
content: India has performed poorly in integrating health into national climate change action plan, according to a new global scorecard. The finding is significant given the country’s vulnerability to climate-related illness and premature death. The report, “ Healthy NDC Scorecard ”, published by the Global Climate and Health Alliance, assessed how well countries incorporate health considerations into their Nationally Determined Contributions (NDCs). These are national climate action plans submitted under the Paris Agreement, setting out commitments to reduce greenhouse gas emissions and adapt to climate change.
